identity.title: Protoplanetary Disks in the Hostile Environment of Carina

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report the first direct imaging of protoplanetary disks in the star-forming region of Carina, the most distant, massive cluster in which disks have been imaged.

question.value: Are protoplanetary disks present in Carina's evaporating gas globules and the Tr 14 core, and what do their masses imply for external photo-evaporation?

evidence.quote: we present novel observations with the Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array (ALMA) of YSO disks in Carina and investigate the implications for disk survival in the face of external photo-evaporation.
The observations were performed on 2015 October 27 as part of the Cycle 3 program 2015.1.01323.S.
Continuum images were obtained in Band 6

why_this_method.value: High spatial resolution ALMA overcomes stellar crowding in Tr 14

limitations_admitted.value: Masses may be underestimated in the optically thick centre; half of Tr 14 YSOs near field edge with lower sensitivity
